title: SQL Server change tracking: the utility's DDL support objects draw a WARN that they may be removed

found.by: 2026-10-26 test round: SQL Server 2022 CU27, change tracking, standard gateway, one run

symptom: With the utility's @CreateDdlSupportingObjects = 1, the gateway logged: "Non-trigger-based DDL for Change Tracking is active and CT DDL support objects were detected ... may be safely removed". The update COMPLETED.
cause: The setup created the objects; the gateway's message says they may not be needed.
effect: A warning in the gateway log; the run wasn't affected.
fix: Leave them. Removing them wasn't tested.
